Locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 9; Table 3 is printed p.12, PDF p.21). A review of public techno-economic analyses, not a new model: Table 3 summarises seven company or institute PEA/PFS estimates of direct lithium extraction (DLE) from geothermal, oilfield, evaporite and salar brines. Loaded: per project annual output, total CAPEX, total OPEX and production cost per t (all reprinted from the original studies). Tables 4-7 OPEX breakdowns (electricity, gas, reagents), IRR, product price and resources are in other-values. The report prints NO energy (kWh, GJ) per t LCE and no reagent quantities, so nothing was loaded for specific-energy-consumption; the to-get.csv expectation of energy and reagent use per t LCE is not met. Table 2 (lithium species conversion factors) is an image and was not read. No flows, measures or emissions.

Currency is USD as printed but Vulcan (euro, rate 1.2) and E3 (CAD, USD total shown) figures were converted by the report; price years are not stated. Pure Energy Minerals production cost is printed as 3,217 (same as Vulcan) while OPEX/output gives 3,175. Lake Resources total OPEX is 106,539 k in Table 3 but 106.8 M in Table 7. Production "mt/yr" is Li2CO3 or LiOH.H2O product tonnes, not uniformly LCE. Anson Paradox PEA was retracted in June 2020 (cost estimates said to remain valid).
